name: Queen's Park Playground
description: Play area in Chesterfield's main town park, run by Chesterfield Borough Council, with North Lodge café and a miniature train in the park. The play area was closed for repairs after flooding in early 2024, with the decking and sand replaced.

sources.label: Derbyshire Times: Queen's Park play area damaged by flood (Jan 2024)
